description: This file defines a mock class 'AudioOutputPortMock' for unit testing purposes, inheriting from 'device::AudioOutputPortImpl' and using Google Mock to mock its methods.

classes.name: AudioOutputPortMock
classes.description: Mock class simulating 'device::AudioOutputPortImpl' behavior for testing;

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Mocks the retrieval of the port's name as a constant string reference.

methods.name: getMS12AudioProfileList
methods.description: Mocks the retrieval of available MS12 audio profiles as a vector of strings.

methods.name: getAudioCapabilities
methods.description: Mocks setting or retrieving audio capabilities via an integer pointer.

methods.name: getMS12Capabilities
methods.description: Mocks setting or retrieving MS12 capabilities via an integer pointer.

methods.name: isAudioMSDecode
methods.description: Mocks checking if audio MS decoding is enabled.
